description: This file defines the LeaveRequestComment entity class using Doctrine ORM annotations, representing a comment associated with a leave request in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like id, leaveRequest, creation timestamp, creator user or employee, and comment text, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: LeaveRequestComment
classes.description: Represents a comment on a leave request, including metadata such as creator and timestamp, mapped via Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave request comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave request comment.

methods.name: getLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns the leave request associated with this comment.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates this comment with a specific leave request.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the comment.
